messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Release v2026.04.01 -> prod paused by preflight: env parity check failed for `CACHE_URL`. staging encodes as sops-json object, prod expects plain URL string. See preflight: https://ci.internal/runs/10011

marta: Ugh. Can someone paste the failing snippet?

ci-bot: preflight excerpt:
```
staging: CACHE_URL={"url":"redis://cache.stg:6379","tls":true}
prod: CACHE_URL=redis://cache.prod:6379?ssl=true
```

diego: This happened after the secret-schema rollout for stateful services. We migrated to structured secrets to include metadata, but the cache client lib still expects a plain env var.

marta: Canary showed app crashes during cache init when it tried to parse the JSON. 502s for first 30s.

ops-oncall: Change window ends in 3h. If we need a prod change we need infra lead approval.

diego: Options: 1) rollback to v2026.03.31 artifact and backfill staging parity 2) add an init container that flattens CACHE_URL JSON -> CACHE_URL_STRING for affected pods 3) bump the client lib and release a minor version (longer).

marta: Rollback is quick but will conflict with other pinned model changes. Init container hotpatch seems lowest blast radius. I can prepare it.

ops-oncall: Security note: any hotpatch must not log secret contents. Add audit event for paramstore writes.

diego: I'll add a compatibility alias in paramstore named CACHE_URL_STR and populate it with the DSN for the canary. Leave original key intact. ETA 20m.

ci-bot: Reminder: integration tests that assert exact env strings may fail; update CI to read CACHE_URL_STR when present.

marta: Spinning up 10% canary with normalizer init that sets CACHE_URL_STRING env if payload is JSON. Will run 15m smoke.

diego: Alias created and audit logged. No rotation applied.

marta: Canary smoke green for 10m. No parse errors, no increased error rate. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Infra eyeballs OK. Approve limited rollout. Keep rollback ready in case of anomalies.

marta: I'll update release notes: "pause due to cache secret schema drift; temporary compatibility alias CACHE_URL_STR created; follow-up: standardize secret schema and remove alias." Confluence: https://confluence/internal/releases/v2026.04.01-secret-drift

deploy-bot: Release v2026.04.01 status: PAUSED -> CANARY (init-normalizer) -> LIMITED_ROLLOUT pending. Assigned: diego (alias/backfill), marta (canary/hotpatch), ops-oncall (monitor). Action items logged.

ci-bot: preflight id=10011 updated: failing checks resolved after alias+init-normalizer. Tests updated to use CACHE_URL_STR when present."
